name: Randee Deich
bio: Randee Deich serves as Director of Talent Attraction & Education for the Greater Fort Lauderdale Alliance, leading regional strategies that connect employers, educators, and students to strengthen Broward County's talent pipeline. He oversees early career programs that have advanced thousands of students from career exploration into job-connected pathways and leads the South Florida TechGateway initiative spanning Miami-Dade, Broward, and Palm Beach counties. A recipient of the Broward Education Foundation Hall of Fame Educator Award and the South Florida Tech Hub Golden Palm Award, Randee has been nationally recognized for designing scalable, employer-driven models that align education and workforce development.His work continues to shape partnerships that attract, develop, and retain high-wage talent across technology, aviation, and marine innovation sectors.
